name: DIVIDED_ROAD_ENDS_YELLOW_DIAMOND

w4-4_divided_road.desc: Y (divided road) symbol as W4-4; W4-6 is the same symbol inverted.

notes: Diamond 750 side drawn as bounding square 750*sqrt2 = 1060.66 (centre 530.33); R50 outer, 10 yellow edge, 30 black border (as drawing). From the W4-4 drawing (lower diamond 'W4-6 (W4-4 INVERTED)'); no separate PNG. Symbol centred and flipped vertically (flip v mirrors about the sign centreline; box is centred so position is exact). 2026-09-08 drawing check: border was 30; the W4-4 drawing this sign is taken from gives 30 as the distance from the sign edge to the inside of the border (edge + border), so the yellow edge 10 + black border 20, as W4-4 (pixel check 18-20).
